issue.title: sase repo open plans fails applying commit b10820e6: non-bead conflict in split_patch_handler.md
issue.description: 'sase repo open plans' fails applying commit b10820e6 ("Add SDD files for split_patch_handler") with a non-bead conflict in 202608/split_patch_handler.md, though the worktree is clean afterwards. Proposed by sase-js.9 (Adoption, glossary, and documentation) during landing of epic sase-js (Artifact reference contract). Reproduction: 'sase repo open plans' in workspace 14 hit the rebase/apply conflict on that commit; the plans worktree is clean after the failed attempt.
